options.content:
Prometheus cannot see sidecar freshness directly.

* `GET /health/sync` returns `{"status": "ok"}` (200) or `{"status": "stale"}` (503) — point the uptime monitor at it with a keyword check for `"stale"`.
* `python -m jobs.championship_sync --once && python -m jobs.check_sync_health` runs in the daily cron; a non-zero exit fires the cron-failure alert.
* Per-championship detail (behind login): `/analytics/championship/sync-health`.
